scripts.dev: npm run build -w @payscope/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @payscope/api" "npm run dev -w @payscope/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @payscope/shared && npm run dev -w @payscope/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @payscope/shared && npm run dev -w @payscope/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @payscope/shared && npm run build -w @payscope/api && npm run build -w @payscope/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @payscope/shared && npm run typecheck -w @payscope/api && npm run typecheck -w @payscope/web
